capabilities.name: category-aggregate
capabilities.description: Read the m_provision_category aggregate (id, categoryName, categoryDescription) by its primary key, as returned by GET /v1/provisioningcategory.
capabilities.evidence: Capture CAT-00 under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the four category rows (1 STANDARD, 2 SUB-STANDARD, 3 DOUBTFUL, 4 LOSS), each with a non-empty categoryDescription.

capabilities.name: reserve-amount
capabilities.description: Read the aggregated reserve amount (amountreserved) and its band identity (categoryId, overdueInDays) from GET /v1/provisioningentries/{id}/entries, as produced by POST /provisioningentries.
capabilities.evidence: Capture ENT-04 under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned four aggregated entries (STANDARD 1066.19, SUB-STANDARD 26654.63, DOUBTFUL 74234.32, LOSS 106618.53), each with categoryId and overdueInDays.

seams.name: provisioning-category-read
seams.description: GET /v1/provisioningcategory on the running Fineract server (Path B), tenant gerege: the m_provision_category aggregate rows.

seams.name: provisioning-entry-reserve
seams.description: POST /provisioningentries then GET /v1/provisioningentries/{id}/entries on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the aggregated reserve amount and band identity per entry.

note: Provisioning parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Two capabilities are graded: the category aggregate read (provisioning-category-read seam) and the aggregated reserve amount (provisioning-entry-reserve seam). The age-band match (Matches/ReserveRate) and the overlap invariant (Overlaps/ValidateRange) are NOT in the graded domain: the running oracle produced no matched-band refusal or overlap refusal to transcribe, and producing one would write a deliberately-broken criteria to the tenant (forbidden).
